$comment: The implementation plan in machine-readable form. Agents read this file to choose ready work. Keep it in step with implementation-plan.md; the plan check (WP-0.1) fails CI if they disagree.

stages.title: Walking skeleton
stages.outcome: A preview app for Windows, macOS, and Linux opens to the blank canvas with the trigger. You can type paragraphs and headings into a Markdown file you chose, it saves on its own, and the note is back when you reopen the app.

stages.title: Writing
stages.outcome: Open or create a Markdown file and write a real document: blocks, Markdown shortcuts, inline formatting with the contextual toolbar, links, the slash menu, Loop-style tables, the trigger toolbar and ⋯ menu, focus mode, Light, Dark, and System themes, font size, find and replace, and the Basic and Writer shortcut layers with the cheat sheet.

stages.title: Your Focus Notes on GitHub Pages
stages.outcome: Open your own Focus Notes at your GitHub Pages address in any browser and write at once, kept in this browser and offline. Read the site's public notes, unlock your private notes read-only with your passphrase, and export your browser notes for the desktop app.

stages.title: Desktop sign-in and Git
stages.outcome: The first run signs in through Git's own tools, creates your instance in your GitHub account (instance repository, private repository, vault passphrase, Pages site), and from then on every change is saved as Git commits and synced: the desktop app is the only place that writes to GitHub. Notes are private or public, notes exported from a browser can be imported, conflicts are resolved without loss, and deleted notes can be restored.

stages.title: The desktop app
stages.outcome: The real desktop window (20 px corners and app-built window management on Windows and Linux, the native window and full menu bar on macOS), full screen, and a folder of notes managed in the Files panel, with link updates, crash recovery, and a versioned workspace format.

stages.title: Find anything, make it yours
stages.outcome: Spotlight on <kbd>Mod</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> finds notes, headings, text, folders, commands, and settings, and acts on them. Quick open, find in all notes, the complete Power shortcut layer, and the theme manager with live preview and the contrast guard.

stages.title: Publish and share
stages.outcome: The first public release. Public notes are published to your own GitHub Pages site. Private notes and folders can be shared with named audiences through magic links and passcodes. The Get started page offers the downloads, and every release ships with checksums, an SBOM, and attestations.

stages.title: Agents
stages.outcome: A local MCP server, permissions you control, attributed and undoable agent changes, the `focus-notes` command-line tool with JSON output, `focus-notes://` deep links, and the published design-system catalog.

stages.title: Polish and pro features
stages.outcome: Block handle, column alignment and sorting, the Pro shortcut layer, custom keybindings, find in selection, replace across notes, Spotlight filters and preview, note history, custom and generated themes, synced appearance, multiple windows, signed builds with automatic updates and channels, store listings, and more interface languages.

stages.title: Components
stages.outcome: Image, then gallery, each added as one block registration with directive syntax.

implicitDependency: Every work package depends on the gate of the previous stage, unless lookahead is true.

workPackages.title: Repository, CI, and agent loop
workPackages.summary: The monorepo, toolchain, CI on three operating systems, the license check, CodeQL, Dependabot, actions pinned by SHA, branch protection, the work graph, the agent role instructions, and the benchmark harness with performance marks, spans, and a budgets file checked in CI.

workPackages.title: Editor spike and block registry
workPackages.summary: Both Markdown bridges against the round-trip corpus, the decision recorded, and the block registry contract.

workPackages.title: Token source and build
workPackages.summary: DTCG sources for every tier, Style Dictionary output, and alias checks.

workPackages.title: First primitives, layouts, and contracts
workPackages.summary: Text, Icon, Button, IconButton, Tooltip, SignalDot, Stack, Inline, Surface, Layer, and Positioner, with contracts, the gallery, and the component process.

workPackages.title: UI schema, ui:check, and renderer spike
workPackages.summary: The schema generated from contracts, `ui:check`, the renderer, message keys, and the overhead benchmark on Settings, Files, and Spotlight prototypes.

workPackages.title: Electron shell and window spike
workPackages.summary: The hardened Electron shell with a typed preload bridge, an allow-listed network policy, and the 20 px window spike on Windows 10, Windows 11, and Ubuntu.

workPackages.title: Canvas skeleton
workPackages.summary: The canvas view document with the trigger and a minimal editor saving to a local file, inside the start-time budget.

workPackages.title: File format schemas
workPackages.summary: JSON Schemas for front matter, settings, themes, keybindings, access, and the invite template.

workPackages.title: Nightly and preview builds
workPackages.summary: Unsigned nightly builds from `main`, and preview pre-releases at each stage exit.

workPackages.title: Block editor core
workPackages.summary: Blocks, Markdown shortcuts, undo, round-trip fidelity, the extension syntax, and text in any script.

workPackages.title: Inline formatting, contextual toolbar, and links
workPackages.summary: Marks, the contextual toolbar, the link editor, and the hover card.

workPackages.title: Slash menu and paste
workPackages.summary: The slash menu from the block registry, and sanitized paste of Markdown, HTML, and plain text.

workPackages.title: Compound components, first set
workPackages.summary: Menu, Popover, Dialog, Toolbar, Toast, Field, Tabs, and ResultList, with command-driven items and full gallery coverage, plus the task tracker, the busy state, the wait timing tokens, and the minimal auto-hiding scrollbar.

workPackages.title: Loop-style tables
workPackages.summary: Tables with hover insertion, grips, cell selection, keyboard movement, and spreadsheet paste.

workPackages.title: Trigger toolbar and ⋯ menu
workPackages.summary: The six-action toolbar and the ⋯ menu as view documents, keyboard and screen-reader complete.

workPackages.title: Focus mode
workPackages.summary: The row mask with every edge case, inside the typing budget.

workPackages.title: Commands, keymap, and cheat sheet
workPackages.summary: The command registry, the Basic and Writer layers per platform, browser substitutes, and the cheat sheet.

workPackages.title: Themes, appearance, and modes
workPackages.summary: Paper, Ink, and the other built-ins, System switching, fonts and size, and every token mode including forced colors.

workPackages.title: Find and replace in a note
workPackages.summary: The find bar with live count, options, replace, and replace all as one undo step.

workPackages.title: Writing hardening
workPackages.summary: The stage's accessibility audit, open-note budget, and the M1 demo as an automated journey test.

workPackages.title: Windows and Linux window
workPackages.summary: The transparent 20 px window with app-built moving, resizing, maximizing, snapping, Snap Layouts, the system menu, and DPI handling.

workPackages.title: Title bar, full screen, and macOS menu
workPackages.summary: The title bar band, full screen, and the native macOS menu bar generated from commands.

workPackages.title: Local workspace model
workPackages.summary: The workspace model shared by the web app and the desktop app: the repository and its private submodule as one tree of notes and folders, file names from titles, and the versioned workspace format.

workPackages.title: Files panel and file operations
workPackages.summary: The Files panel in the browser and on the desktop: the tree, create, rename, delete, multiple selection, drag and drop, and Move to…, saved as commits.

workPackages.title: Link updates
workPackages.summary: Relative links updated on every rename and move.

workPackages.title: Recovery journal and resource budgets
workPackages.summary: The one-second recovery journal, memory and idle CPU budgets on 10,000 notes, the parsed-note snapshot, and the warm-up after start.

workPackages.title: Setup engine and workspace template
workPackages.summary: Create my workspace in the user's account from the template, including its AGENTS.md.

workPackages.title: First run and sign-in
workPackages.summary: The setup steps, sign-in through Git Credential Manager, the GitHub CLI, or a token, identity, and create or clone.

workPackages.title: Local Git adapter, save, and sync
workPackages.summary: Commits for every change, push and pull, the lock file, readable commit messages, and one cached Git status per repository that no view waits for.

workPackages.title: Public and private roots
workPackages.summary: Public notes in the instance repository's notes/, private notes in the private repository at private/, new notes private by default, and moving notes between them (D-84).

workPackages.title: Conflicts and Recently deleted
workPackages.summary: The conflict resolver and restoring from Git history.

workPackages.title: Account settings and data inventory
workPackages.summary: Switch account, sign out, and remove a workspace, deleting exactly what the inventory lists.

workPackages.title: Search index
workPackages.summary: A MiniSearch index in a worker, on the device only, inside the budgets.

workPackages.title: Spotlight
workPackages.summary: The command palette with every result type, quick actions, modes, prefixes, and quick open.

workPackages.title: Find in all notes
workPackages.summary: Grouped results across the workspace.

workPackages.title: Power shortcut layer
workPackages.summary: The complete Basic, Writer, and Power layers.

workPackages.title: Theme manager and contrast guard
workPackages.summary: The gallery with live preview, reading settings, and the contrast guard.

workPackages.title: Static renderer and public pages
workPackages.summary: Public pages rendered from the reader views and block components, deployed by the user's workflow, with font preloading and lab-measured Core Web Vitals.

workPackages.title: Share sealing and the pinned bundle
workPackages.summary: Share grants sealed with the vault's format (WP-6.4), and instances deploying the released web app bundle at a pinned version, verified by checksum and attestation.

workPackages.title: Audiences, passcodes, and invites
workPackages.summary: The Share popover, audiences, generated and custom passcodes, expiry, withdrawal, and the invite.

workPackages.title: Share reader
workPackages.summary: The reader with magic links, name and passcode, and the page weight budget.

workPackages.title: Release pipeline and template releases
workPackages.summary: Draft releases with installers, the reader bundle, checksums, SBOM, attestations, and template updates.

workPackages.title: Instance template and update pull requests
workPackages.summary: The template repository generated from templates/workspace/ at each release, its pinned Deploy app workflow, and update pull requests.

workPackages.title: Diagnostics and release qualification
workPackages.summary: Local diagnostics, Report a problem, and the full support-matrix pass for 1.0.

workPackages.title: Glitch-free windows and honest waits
workPackages.summary: No blank or white frame in any transition (no page reloads for state changes, double-buffered swaps, the first themed frame), and every wait in the inventory with its class pattern: named waits, steps and progress, prefetch, starting with setup.

workPackages.title: Snappy window and controls
workPackages.summary: The window attached to the pointer (main-process drag loop or the native move, measured), no queued moves, no repaint on move, resizing that keeps up, a main process that never stalls, and every control answering on pointer-down in the next frame.

workPackages.title: Web app on your own Pages, local first
workPackages.summary: The web build deployed by each instance to its own GitHub Pages; notes written in the browser kept in IndexedDB, offline, with persistent storage; export and import bundles. No GitHub sign-in in the browser.

workPackages.title: Start in the browser, the visitor view, and Use this app for yourself
workPackages.summary: Make your instance from the template; the web first run; the visitor view with public notes only; and the Use this app for yourself dialog.

workPackages.title: The instance's notes in the browser
workPackages.summary: The Deploy app workflow publishes notes/ with an index and a site manifest; the browser lists and opens public notes (and, with WP-6.4, private ones) read-only, with Copy to my notes.

workPackages.title: The vault: private notes sealed at deploy, unlocked in the browser
workPackages.summary: The sealing format and sealer (packages/seal), the owner's grant, the leak check in the Deploy app workflow, and the browser's Unlock, Remember on this browser, Lock, and the account pill.

workPackages.title: Agent permissions and attribution
workPackages.summary: Permission checks in the command layer, agent trailers, undo, and safety rules. The Agent badge and the toast land with WP-8.4 and WP-7.2 (D-145).

workPackages.title: MCP server
workPackages.summary: The stdio MCP server with its tools, resources, and prompts.

workPackages.title: Command-line tool and deep links
workPackages.summary: `focus-notes` with `--json`, and read-only deep links.

workPackages.title: Settings → Agents and the published catalog
workPackages.summary: Connection snippets, permission controls, recent agent changes, and the design-system catalog on the product site.

workPackages.title: Editor pro
workPackages.summary: The block handle, column alignment, sorting, the Pro layer, and find in selection.

workPackages.title: Custom and generated themes
workPackages.summary: Custom themes, sync, named schemes, import, generation from a seed color, and shuffle.

workPackages.title: Toolbar and keybinding customization
workPackages.summary: Choosing the six toolbar actions, and `keybindings.json` with conflict warnings.

workPackages.title: Workspace pro
workPackages.summary: Replace across notes, Spotlight filters and preview, sorting and duplicating, and note history.

workPackages.title: Multiple windows
workPackages.summary: One note per window, with state kept per window.
